findings.summary: Luna's 16 current products include category headings and generic section abstractions, while the reopened official location menu lists dozens of named flavors and pints plus named sundaes and shakes.

Frozen exact-match rows contain complete allergen arrays and negative may-contain arrays attributed to official ingredients, but the reopened location menu provides product descriptions rather than current complete allergen declarations. Only narrow named ingredient positives are supportable; no cross-contact conclusion is available.
The linked takeout API returned an error and an official-linked Grubhub delivery service was omitted by Luna. Neither unresolved service catalog supports a missing-product or allergen negative.

summary: Identity is verified. Luna found the primary official menu and allergen guidance, but its catalog is materially underenumerated and mixes categories with products. The official location menu confirms frozen formula-to-name matches, including Strawberry Cheesecake, yet does not support frozen complete allergen arrays, negative may-contain arrays, or scoop-shop cross-contact conclusions. Linked takeout and third-party delivery remain unresolved service surfaces.
